name: dynamic_skills_engine
title: Evolved Dynamic Skills Adapter Engine
problem_description: Develop a unified dynamic skill adapter engine and execution wrapper `execute_skill(skill_name: str, **kwargs) -> str` that enhances all 29 underlying Economic Research Agent tools. When a skill is invoked with an unknown, non-hardcoded entity (like a tier-2 city, non-standard MSA, county FIPS, or obscure commodity code), the engine must autonomously resolve the missing identifiers via live Serper search or API discovery, cache the mappings locally, and dynamically execute the fetch. It must gracefully fallback to live data scraping if an endpoint returns an error or empty payload.
initial_program_description: Scaffolds the `DynamicSkillEngine` class and the `# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START` block with dynamic FIPS/MSA/HS-Code resolution logic utilizing Serper.dev and local runtime caching wrappers for the 29 underlying tools.
evolve_block_description: Contains the universal `execute_skill` method, the entity discovery logic (regex + Serper API mapping), the local runtime caching dictionary, and API error fallback scrapers.
constraints: Must output the data in valid JSON or identical Markdown format to the underlying native skill for downstream parser compatibility.
Must capture and populate a local runtime cache (`self.entity_cache`) so duplicate queries for the same entity do not hit the Serper API repeatedly.
Must be 100% backward compatible for already-hardcoded cities/counties (should execute immediately without discovery latency).
Must gracefully catch and handle HTTP 401/403/404/500 errors from underlying API endpoints.
